import sys
from typing import List

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print("Difference: 0.0")
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print("Difference: 0.0")
        return
    
    numbers = list(map(float, data[1:n+1]))
    
    max_val = max(numbers)
    min_val = min(numbers)
    diff = max_val - min_val
    
    print(f"Difference: {diff}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
